sources.title: Existing v4 validation selection integer recomputation
Input parity and raw/corrected transcript distinction
sources.details: For fixed photo I, history H and generation settings G, typed question T and recognized question R feed the same core f(I,H,text;G). T=R makes textual histories equal in the fence; changing R changes the actual question. Human corrected C is a different text variable from raw ASR R, so answering C cannot establish that R was correct. This is a method distinction, not a new ability score.

source_verification.details: Personally inspected original Whisper v1 and LoRA v1 PDFs, official Qwen README at pinned model revision, CPython v3.13.5 original docs, and AST-selected exact repository methods. limitations.details: Manual equal text demonstrates input parity only. CPU doubles verify routing, retaining originals and output contract, not actual ASR/Qwen accuracy, obedience, learning or generalization. Existing selection aggregation was checked without training, new grading or full-model inference. Current branch outputs text and does not implement answer speech synthesis; comparison scope must hold photo/history/generation fixed.

intro_summary: 本章延伸沿用已訓練的 Qwen 圖文核心，語音由 Whisper 先轉成文字再交給同一核心；其起點有別於第 19 章的隨機初始化主線。導言說明 LoRA 候選未被驗證支持採用，因此保留底座；短 CPU 範例只隔離機制，不能代表完整成熟模型的能力。
